titleAr: شغّل بوابة الدفع أو شركة الشحن بنفسي
titleEn: Turn on a payment gateway or shipping carrier myself

en: Why is my provider not active yet?
How do I turn on Kashier?

steps: Save the provider keys on the card
Press the on switch: Ebda Store tests the saved keys on the server
If the test passes, confirm Test and turn on; if it fails, read the one-sentence reason and fix the keys
edgeCases: The test result always comes from the server; nothing in the request can make it pass
The confirmation is single use, expires in 2 minutes and is bound to this provider, this mode and this exact test run: a newer test, edited keys or another user refuses it
The confirm call needs an Idempotency-Key; the same key twice enables once
A provider with no safe test call turns on with an unverified warning and the Ebda Store team is paged on its first connection (P1)
Another store's provider answers 404; staff without store settings permission are refused
The failure sentence is AI-written from the measured error code only (never keys); the fixed sentence is the fallback
Turn it off from the same switch; platform staff can also deactivate it for a store with a note
